title: Google Flights prices
description: Two row types share one dataset: flight (one itinerary for a route, date and cabin) and status (one per route and date; never charged).

dataset.title: Google Flights prices
dataset.description: One row per flight itinerary, plus status rows. Charged rows are billed as delivered; status rows are always free.

summary.title: Run summary
summary.description: One JSON record with the counts this run delivered and charged, its error and duplicate tallies, and its HTTP stats.
